Position drags translate its interval; release and review Min/Max. Fixed states and links remain enforced.
Components are faint, shifted or absent
Check Focus Mode, component visibility and Offset components. Those controls change the view, not fitted contributions.
No Total or residual is visible
Total appears for peaks/edges; residuals require data plus peaks, edges or linear background. Gain/dE alone do not create those components.

A fit converges but seems implausible
Inspect residual structure, bound hits, compensating parameters and sensitivity to sensible seeds. Convergence alone does not validate a scientific model.
Series trends cannot be enabled for a parameter
Trends require an independent per-spectrum parameter and simultaneous fitting. Shared parameters already have one value; linked targets use their controlling source/separation.
